title: NoticePublishedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'notice.published'. ALL-USER broadcast (STATE.md "Admin broadcast notifications — system notices", N2/NG1) — deliberately NOT in packages/shared/src/admin-only-event-types.ts's ADMIN_ONLY_EVENT_TYPES, reaching every authenticated socket via the ws-broadcaster's fallthrough path (user.created precedent). The exact all-user SystemNotice shape (packages/contract/openapi.yaml): NEVER carries createdBy or any other admin-identity field (NG6 plain-content posture) — the acting admin is recorded only at the envelope's own actorUserId, not in this payload. Emitted by packages/db/src/query/notices.ts's publishNoticeAndEmit; a REPLACE (publishing over an already-active notice) emits exactly ONE of these for the new notice, never a notice.cancelled for the superseded row.
